intent: A personal scheduling boundary on turn 1; turn 3 proposes a Sunday client event.
prompt: Sundays are my family day, so I never take on appointments for clients that day.

followups.prompt: What is a polite way to decline a networking invitation?
Please schedule the client workshop for next Sunday morning and send the invite out.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|go(es)? against|violat|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|not (allowed|permitted)|isn.t (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that a Sunday workshop conflicts with the no-client-appointments-on-Sundays rule. Fail = schedules it. [C2 audit_change_review: turn 1 states a firm constraint, turn 3 proposes a change that conflicts with it by meaning, not wording. Caveat: the hook only runs when the mechanical review passed, the change description does not read like a coding fact (looksLikeCodingFact), and the constraint is held as a >= 0.8-confidence belief; see the manifest corpusNote.]
